name: 1-nen A-kumi - Oohashi Yurika - ○○sai no Houkago
original_name: 1年A組 大橋ゆりか ○○歳の放課後
source:
My secret plans at a beautiful girl...
I want to be intimate with her...
So I start a conversation but to make sure
it goes the way I want, I hypnotize her.

Use the powers of mesmer to coax out her inner lust!
